title: Three Young Children, Overalls Lawn Yard - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot capturing three young children huddled together outdoors on a grassy lawn. The child on the far left wears dark overalls over a long-sleeved shirt (partially obscured by surface paper loss/damage), the child in the center wears a light-colored suit or matching outfit, and the youngest boy on the right wears overalls over a horizontally striped shirt. In the background across the open field stands a modest mid-century residential house and surrounding bare trees under daylight.
